answer: A near-duplicate is rejected at the ferrous gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Copying an answer thus yields nothing, and producing 134 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the canyon ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the willow review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
